notes: Corrected only the source head of מִתַּחַת → beneath: rule 23 heads a compound of two prepositions on the first (מֵעַל, מֵאֵת precedent), not on the morpheme whose sense the English happens to carry. מִמַּעַל keeps its head on the adverb, which is a content morpheme; both competing readings are named in the notes.
